test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A man wanted to sell his cycle at 30% profit but actually sold it at 30% loss for ₹2,100. At what price (in ₹) did he want to sell the cycle to earn the profit of 30%?
solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 30%

Selling price = Rs. 2100, when there is a loss of 30%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price - Cost price × loss%

Selling price = Cost price + Cost price × profit%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. A

Selling price = A – A × 30%

According to the question,

A – A × 30% = 2100

⇒ 0.7A = 2100

⇒ A = 2100/0.7

⇒ A = 3000

So, the cost price of the cycle = Rs. 3000

Now,

Selling price at 30% profit = 3000 + 3000 × 30%

⇒ Rs. 3900

**∴ He wants to sell the cycle to earn a profit of 30% at 3900 (in ₹).**

5f
